perks.name: Stardust Dash
perks.description: Press Space to perform a rapid dash leaving a trail of stardust — dodging monster attacks and traversing mines swiftly.
perks.unlock_hint: Restore Chapter I of Grandma's Grimoire (Requires 3 Stardust Powder + 5 Crystal Gems)

perks.name: Crystal Sight
perks.description: While wielding a pickaxe, subterranean walls containing precious ores shimmer brightly through the rock face.
perks.unlock_hint: Conquer Floor 25 of the Mines & gift Boris the Blacksmith 1 Amethyst Crystal

perks.name: Crescent Slash
perks.description: Increases sword and scythe attack arc width by 50%.
perks.unlock_hint: Forge your first Copper-tier weapon at Boris's Forge

perks.name: Automated Sprinkler
perks.description: Crafted from Stone Crab Shell + Copper Ore — automatically irrigates a 3x3 plot every morning at 06:00.
perks.unlock_hint: Craft at Carpenter Workbench (Requires 5 Copper Ore + 1 Crystal Gem)

perks.name: Auto-Preserve Jar
perks.description: Crafted from Slime Jelly + Forest Hardwood — automatically ferments fruit jams and honey syrups.
perks.unlock_hint: Harvest your first Lumiberry crop & reach Farming Level 2

perks.name: Customer Empathy
perks.description: Displays subtle emotion icons above visitors' heads when they step in — intuiting what tea or pastry they crave.
perks.unlock_hint: Reach Shop Fame Level 2 & serve 20 cups of Calming Lotus Tea

perks.name: Golden Kneader
perks.description: Increases dough kneading speed by 30%; grants a 20% chance for baked goods to achieve 3-Star Masterpiece quality.

perks.name: Dual Kettle Mastery
perks.description: Allows placing two teapots simultaneously onto the stove, doubling tea brewing capacity.
perks.unlock_hint: Upgrade to Dual Stove Countertop at Boris's Forge (10 Iron Ore + 500 Gold)
